mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings made since 2024: the thrust main slips onto the cap and block side groove too easily, raising a spun-thrust-bearing risk. The poster says King tech support confirmed the 2024 main bearings were out of spec on free spread.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports the factory put wrong bearings in a standard-marked box, with 0.25 shells mixed into a shrink-wrapped STD set, and tells readers to measure every shell before install.
